recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Revisit only if the existing downloads/XML/validation warnings are removed or if the downloadable schema archive later gains a maintained README mechanism that needs explicit source wiring.
issue_request: FHIR-6799 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 and asked for warnings, preferably around the schema download, that schemas and schematrons do not enforce every FHIR conformance rule and that implementers must still understand the specification and applicable profiles. The resolution was to add warnings and references to generated schematrons for profiles.
initial_application: SVN revision 6393, represented by git commit 56b5aa5b881daf312d25d7905f78cfc809d5cd25, added source/downloads.html prose warning that schemas and schematrons do not contain all rules for valid resources and that implementers need the specification and applicable profiles. Later downloads-page reorganization preserved the warning in broader wording for all derived download forms.
additional_context: The current Downloads page is linked from current documentation and implementation-support navigation. It identifies the definitions package as the master source and warns that the other forms below, including schema downloads, are incomplete subsets. The current XML and Validation pages also warn that schema plus Schematron validity is insufficient for conformance, describe generated-schematron/profile limitations, and say human inspection of applicable implementation guides and the base specification is the final arbiter. Confluence and Zulip searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current built source already conveys the warning and profile/schematron limitations requested by the Jira, so duplicating the warning in another README-style location would not change implementer understanding and could create maintenance drift.
